```ts
  persian?: boolean

  audit?: false | AuditPluginOptions
  logger?: boolean
};
```

**Exported from:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-preset`

Public type exported by @nexload-sdk/payload-preset.

[Source](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/blob/main/packages/payload-preset/src/index.ts#L16)

## Exported Factories Summary

`nexloadPreset(options?: NexloadPresetOptions): Plugin[]` returns the enabled plugins. `persianPlugin()` and `payloadLoggerPlugin()` are also available separately. The package re-exports `AuditOperation` and `AuditPluginOptions`, and exports `NexloadPresetOptions`.

Import `payloadFieldsPlugin` from `@nexload-sdk/payload-fields` and `auditPlugin` from `@nexload-sdk/payload-hooks`. This package is ESM only and intended for Node.js Payload configuration.

---

# Production Guides & Recipes

Options, merge rules, ordering, and logging for the Payload preset.

**Topic:** guides
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-preset` v0.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-preset/guides/
## Options

| Option | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `persian` | `true` | Persian admin defaults; set `false` to disable. |
| `logger` | `true` | Bridge SDK options when `config.logger` is unset; set `false` to disable. |
| `fields` | `{}` | Options for `payloadFieldsPlugin`; set `false` to disable. |
| `audit` | `{}` | Options for `auditPlugin`; set `false` to disable. |

`payloadFieldsPlugin` runs at order 900 and `auditPlugin` at 1000. Ordinary host plugins run first, so their collections are available to both. The preset does not add, remove, or change collection fields. Define them with [Payload Schema](/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-schema/) and [Payload Fields](/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-fields/).

## Persian merge rules

The Persian plugin preserves host languages, fallback language, and default timezone. It adds Persian translations if absent, defaults the fallback to `fa`, and adds `Asia/Tehran` to supported timezones. It sets RTL only on existing `fa` locale objects without an explicit RTL value. It never creates localization or adds locales.

## Logger bridge

Call `configureLogger()` before `buildConfig()`. When `config.logger` is unset, the plugin uses the options form from `getPayloadLoggerConfig()`; Payload creates its own Pino logger. It has no `success()` method and maps the SDK `success` threshold to `warn`. Payload writes JSON in development unless `configureLogger({ destination })` supplies a stream. Rebuild the Payload config after forced SDK reconfiguration. See the [logger API](/nexload-sdk/packages/logger/api/).

## Audit boundaries

Audit reads are off by default; auth is on. The implicit default users collection is created after plugins run and is not audited: declare it explicitly. Write events are emitted before transaction commit and may describe rolled-back changes. See [Payload Hooks](/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-hooks/) for options and events.

The `getPayloadLoggerConfig()` bridge maps the SDK `success` threshold to Payload `warn`. Payload’s logger has no `success()` method.

---

# Overview & Quick Start

Compose Payload configuration with Nexload defaults.

**Topic:** overview
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-preset` v0.0.0
**Canonical page:** https://gecut.github.io/nexload-sdk/packages/payload-preset/
**Package:** `@nexload-sdk/payload-preset`

**Current released version:** `0.0.0`

[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nexload-sdk/payload-preset) · [Source](https://github.com/gecut/nexload-sdk/tree/main/packages/payload-preset)

`nexloadPreset()` composes Persian admin defaults, the SDK logger bridge, field hooks, and collection audit logging. It is ESM only and runs in Node.js Payload configuration.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add @nexload-sdk/payload-preset @nexload-sdk/logger payload @payloadcms/translations
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { configureLogger } from "@nexload-sdk/logger";
import { nexloadPreset } from "@nexload-sdk/payload-preset";
import { buildConfig } from "payload";

configureLogger({ service: "shop-cms" });
export default buildConfig({
  // Add db, secret, and collections here.
  plugins: [...nexloadPreset()],
});
```

Configure the logger before `buildConfig()`. Define collections explicitly, including the auth collection. See [guides](./guides/) and the [API reference](./api/).
